g.text: BrewPi device config on all three: A0 chamber temp, pin 5 chamber heater (Act 1), pin 6 chamber cooler (Act 2), "not inverted" — a high closes the relay.

g.desc: BrewPi device config on all three: A0 chamber temp, pin 5 chamber heater (Act 1), pin 6 chamber cooler (Act 2), "not inverted" — a high closes the relay.

g.text: Heater feeds are the 7.5 A fuses V3–V5 via strip 2; heater 0 V returns to the fuse block V−. Pump 24 V comes via strip 3 and leaves on strip 4.

g.desc: Heater feeds are the 7.5 A fuses V3–V5 via strip 2; heater 0 V returns to the fuse block V−. Pump 24 V comes via strip 3 and leaves on strip 4.

g.text: Heat/cool relays: unitank-1 = 1/4, unitank-2 = 2/5, chronical = 3/6. Unos left→right on the panel in that order.

g.desc: Heat/cool relays: unitank-1 = 1/4, unitank-2 = 2/5, chronical = 3/6. Unos left→right on the panel in that order.

g.text: Sheet 3 — brewpi: relay drives, mode lines, hot-side probes, serial to the message centre and speedo, the left switch pod, and the three BrewPi Remix controllers with their heaters and glycol pumps.

g.desc: Sheet 3 — brewpi: relay drives, mode lines, hot-side probes, serial to the message centre and speedo, the left switch pod, and the three BrewPi Remix controllers with their heaters and glycol pumps.
